nomenclature.etymology_html:
-Suregada : From the Telugu name (from India), soora gade for Suregada multiflora (Juss.) Baill.
-Lanceolata : From the Latin lancea, lanceae and meaning narrowed and tapered at both ends (lanceolate).

flower.text: The flowers of Suregada lanceolata are unisexual on separate individuals. The male flowers are grouped in axillary umbellate (5-8-flowered). The calyx-tube is 5-lobed and 3 mm long and 2 mm across. The calyx-lobes are concave, thick and imbricate and about 3 mm long. The corolla is absent. The androecium is composed of 25 stamens mixed with glands. The filaments are filiform and about 1.5 mm long and connate and the anthers are 1-1.2 mm long. The female flowers are grouped in axillary 3-5-flowered, leaf-opposed and paired clusters. The calyx-lobes are 5, ovate, finely ciliate and 3 mm long. The corolla is absent. The pistil is composed of 3 styles and a globose ovary.

leaf.text: The leaves of Suregada lanceolata grow alternately on the stem (spirally arranged). The leaf is simple, bright green-coloured above and paler beneath. The leaf is coriaceous and glabrous on both sides. The leaves have a 5 mm long petiole . The leaf of Suregada lanceolata is 6-8 cm long and 3-3.5 cm wide. The shape of the blade is obovate to oblanceolate, the apex is obtuse, the base is cuneate and the margins are entire. The venation of the leaf is reticulate with a prominent midrib.

habit.text: Suregada lanceolata is a thornless, small-sized and evergreen tree growing up to 8-10 m high.
habit.text_html: Suregada lanceolata is a thornless, small-sized and evergreen tree growing up to 8-10 m high.

stem_bark.text: The bark of Suregada lanceolata is dark grey-coloured, smooth and longitudinaly fissured.
stem_bark.text_html: The bark of Suregada lanceolata is dark grey-coloured, smooth and longitudinaly fissured.

seed.text: The seeds of Suregada lanceolata are found by 3 in the 3-lobbed smooth capsule. The seeds are globose and have a hard shell. The seeds are dented like tiny golf balls.

fruit.text: The fruit of Suregada lanceolata is an ovoid and deeply 3-lobed capsule . The fruit is about 1-1.5 cm across. There is one seed per lobe.

ecology.text: Suregada lanceolata is found in evergreen forests in coastal zones and in dry evergreen forests in leeward side. Source : BIOTIK - Biodiversity Informatics and co-Operation in Taxonomy for Interactive shared Knowledge base, http://www.biotik.org
ecology.text_html:
• Ecology :

    Suregada lanceolata is found in evergreen forests in coastal zones and in dry evergreen forests in leeward side.

    Source : BIOTIK - Biodiversity Informatics and co-Operation in Taxonomy for Interactive shared Knowledge base, http://www.biotik.org

reproduction_dispersal.text: Suregada lanceolata is dioecious . The species has unisexual flowers on separate trees (either only male or only female flowers). No individual plant of the population produces both pollen and ovules. Suregada lanceolata is pollinated by a wide variety of insects. Mechanical dispersal : barochory (dispersal of seeds by gravity), self-propagation. The ripe and dry capsules of Suregada lanceolata opens to scatter the seeds.
reproduction_dispersal.text_html:
• Sex distribution :

    Suregada lanceolata is dioecious. The species has unisexual flowers on separate trees (either only male or only female flowers). No individual plant of the population produces both pollen and ovules.

  • Mode of pollination :

    Suregada lanceolata is pollinated by a wide variety of insects.

  • Seed dispersal :

    Mechanical dispersal : barochory (dispersal of seeds by gravity), self-propagation.
    The ripe and dry capsules of Suregada lanceolata opens to scatter the seeds.

medicinal.text: The seed paste of Suregada lanceolata is applied to treat leprosy. ( Quattrocchi, 2012, CRC World Dictionary of Medicinal and Poisonous Plants ) The roots are used in curing fever by tribes of Andhra Pradesh (India). ( eFlora of India, http://efloraindia.nic.in )

reforestation.text: Suregada lanceolata can be planted in full sun or half-shade. It will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining. The species is propagated by seeds. 24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
reforestation.text_html:
• Planting advice and requirements :

    Suregada lanceolata can be planted in full sun or half-shade. It will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils but all soils need to be free draining.
    The species is propagated by seeds.

  • Seed treatments :

    24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
